title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：parent　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 parent 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the grandmother ① honoured the parent that no child in the courtyard would have recorded, and he said the honouring was the whole of the year. The ② parent, meaning the guardian itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a parent, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ parent in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ parent at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A parent, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the grandmother said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the parent was the whole of the matter, meaning the duty and not the guardian. The ⑥ parent, meaning the duty and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; parent, he said, is either something you honour or the only word that means both a guardian and a duty. He said the duty is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ parent had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ parent of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of recording; parent, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ parent I remember is the guardian recorded in the diary, which closed in 1977 and is still recorded as the quietest in the courtyard. A ⑩ parent, my mother said in 1979, is the only guardian that improves by being recorded; every parent, she said, is a duty that has agreed to look like a guardian. She said the duty was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 父（母）亲（指院子里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 父（母）亲（指那位父（母）亲本身，与小小的灯相对）
C. 固定搭配：honour the parent 敬这一位父（母）亲
D. n. 父（母）亲（指留给孩子们守着的那一件）
E. n. 父（母）亲之事（抽象总称，指一处院子的父（母）亲之事）
F. n. 父（母）亲（指日记里写到、被记载的那一位）
G. n. 父（母）亲、养育（指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 养育（抽象总称，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: honoured the parent that no child in the courtyard would have recorded
The parent, meaning the guardian itself and not the lamp
the parent at the far window
the parent was the whole of the matter
the parent had become a line in a diary
The parent of the whole thing
A parent, my mother said in 1979

answers.why: honour the parent 意为“敬这一位父（母）亲”，1970 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯记载的一位父（母）亲做了一遍。
parent 意为“父（母）亲”，指那位父（母）亲本身而不是小小的灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
parent 意为“父（母）亲”，指院子里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
parent 意为“父（母）亲”，指最远那扇窗边的留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
parent 意为“父（母）亲、养育”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位养育就是那件事的全部。
parent 意为“养育”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位父（母）亲，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
parent 意为“父（母）亲”，指日记里写到、被记载的那一位，到 1975 年这一位成了日记里的一行。
parent 意为“父（母）亲之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的父（母）亲之事是一处院子和三个年头的记载。
parent 意为“父（母）亲”，我记得的是日记里记载过的那一位，1977 年过完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一位。
parent 为抽象总称，母亲 1979 年说，父（母）亲是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的父（母）亲。
